summary: A bare, unsuffixed integer literal swizzled to a vector (e.g. (123).xx) stays 64-bit through the swizzle in DXC's default/pre-HLSL2021 language mode; feeding it to asuint/asint/asfloat produces a type-mismatched call that trips an assert in Debug builds and fails DXIL validation (Invalid record / Validation failed.) in Release builds. Always-repro'd across all 20 probeable stable releases and on current Compiler Explorer trunk. -HV 2021 does not fix it; only the newer, still-experimental -HV 202x preview mode does. Maintainer (damyanp) marked the issue dormant: fixed only by the HLSL 202x language change, would review a targeted codegen fix. The same defect closed #5082 (an earlier, related report) as resolved under identical HLSL-202x reasoning.
title: `as` casts on integer constant swizzles result in invalid module bitcode (or assert in debug)
